items.title: 1.1.1.1 What is a Class Diagram? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of class diagrams (PDF 22-23).

blocks.text: Class diagram ek naqshe (map) jaisa hai jo dikhata hai ke system mein cheezein kaise organized (tarteeb se rakhi) hain, bilkul waise jaise aap apna kamra tarteeb se rakhte hain. Is se hum dekh sakte hain ke har dabbe (box) mein kya hai (jaise khilone, kitabein ya kapre) aur yeh dabbe aapas mein kaise jure hain.
Apna kamra tarteeb se rakhne ki misal mein:

items: Room (kamra): poori jagah jis mein baqi sab cheezein hain; class diagram ki main banawat (structure) jaisa.
Box (dabba): kamre ke andar ek container; diagram mein class jaisa.
Attributes: har dabbe mein khaas cheezein hoti hain, jaise 'ToyBox' mein khilone ya 'BookBox' mein kitabein.
Methods: dabbe kuch kaam kar sakte hain, jaise 'open' (kholna) ya 'close' (band karna); class diagram ke methods bhi batate hain ke class kya kaam kar sakti hai.
Khaas dabbe (Specific Boxes): khilono ke liye 'ToyBox', kitabon ke liye 'BookBox' aur kapron ke liye 'ClothesBox'; yeh aam 'Box' class ki alag alag khaas qismein hain.

blocks.text: To class diagram bas ek tareeqa hai yeh dikhane ka ke system (jaise aap ka kamra) ke mukhtalif hisse kaise mil kar kaam karte hain, ta ke sab kuch ek nazar mein samajh aa jaye, jaisa Figure 1.10 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Class ke dabbe: oopar Room (-name: String, -size: String), saada lakeer se Box (-label: String, -contents: String) se jura. Neeche ToyBox (-toys: List), BookBox (-books: List) aur ClothesBox (-clothes: List), har ek ki lakeer khokhli tikon (hollow triangle) par khatam hoti hai jo oopar Box ki taraf ishara karti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.10: Kamra organize karne ka class diagram (kitab ki Figure 1.10 ke mutabiq apni banayi hui drawing, UML ke inheritance (virasat) wale arrowhead ke saath).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein ToyBox, BookBox aur ClothesBox se Box tak saada khuli teer-nok (open arrowhead) bani hai. UML mein inheritance (virasat), yani 'yeh dabba Box ki ek khaas qism hai', khokhli tikon (hollow triangle) wali nok se dikhai jati hai; khuli nok kisi aur rishte ka nishan hai. Is liye yahan sahi UML nishan banaya gaya hai. Room aur Box ke darmiyan saada lakeer sirf yeh batati hai ke dono classes aapas mein jure hain. Har dabbe mein oopar class ka naam aur neeche us ke attributes hain; '-' ka matlab private hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 1.10 mein ToyBox, BookBox aur ClothesBox se Box tak khuli teer-nok (open arrowhead) bani hai. UML mein "yeh Box ki khaas qism hai" (inheritance) khokhli tikon (hollow triangle) wali nok se dikhaya jata hai, jaisa upar ki figure mein bana hai.

blocks.prompt: Kamre ki misal mein class, attribute aur method ka kirdar kaun ada karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dabba (Box) class hai; us ke andar ki cheezein (label, khilone, kitabein, kapre) attributes hain; jo kaam dabba kar sakta hai (open, close) woh methods hain.

items: Class diagram: classes (attributes aur methods ke saath) aur un ke rishte; kamre ke dabbon ki misal (Fig. 1.10).
ToyBox, BookBox aur ClothesBox aam Box class ki khaas qismein hain.
